parameters.query:
INSERT INTO contracts (channel_id, campaign, payout_amount, post_deadline)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
ON CONFLICT (channel_id, campaign) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'draft',
      payout_amount = EXCLUDED.payout_amount,
      post_deadline = EXCLUDED.post_deadline
  WHERE contracts.status = 'failed'
RETURNING id;
UPDATE contracts SET status = 'failed' WHERE id = $1;

INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, details)
VALUES ('contract', $1, 'contract_failed', $2::jsonb);
